summary: Daedalus Special Acquisition Corp., a Cayman-incorporated, London-based Nasdaq-listed blank check company, filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026 disclosing a non-binding Letter of Intent signed September 8, 2026 to combine with HUBX Yazılım Hizmetleri A.Ş. (HubX), a Türkiye-based consumer AI developer, via a de-SPAC business combination that would make HubX a Nasdaq-listed public company. No price, exchange ratio, premium, valuation, or closing date were disclosed. Definitive agreements, due diligence, shareholder and regulatory approvals, and an F-4 proxy/prospectus remain outstanding. Watch for definitive agreement terms, redemption levels, and PIPE financing.
